abort.battery_profile_storage_unrecognized: Stored profile data is from a schema version this version of the integration does not recognize. It has been left untouched; profiles cannot be added, edited or deleted until this is resolved.

migration_id_collision.title: Inverter identity migration is waiting on a duplicate
migration_id_collision.description: {title}: {reason}. The integration keeps running on its previous identifiers - entities, history and automations are unaffected. Remove or rename the duplicate under Settings > Devices & services > Entities (or Devices), then restart Home Assistant to finish the migration.

advanced_settings_available.title: More settings are available
advanced_settings_available.description: {title}: optional advanced settings can unlock output and battery controls. WARNING! An incorrect value here may cut off power to the load or damage the battery - enable only if you know how to adjust battery voltage and current. You can enable them here, or later under Configure.

battery_profile_apply_mixed_state.title: Battery profile change left settings in a mixed state
battery_profile_apply_mixed_state.description: {title}: a profile change could not be fully undone after it failed partway through, so the battery may now be running on a mix of two profiles. Details: {detail}. Check the battery voltage and current settings by hand, or apply a profile again once you know what state the battery is in - a confirmed match clears this.

battery_profile_apply_transport_unknown.title: Connection lost while changing the battery profile
battery_profile_apply_transport_unknown.description: {title}: the connection was lost partway through a profile change, after at least one setting had already been sent. The rollback was never attempted, so the last known state before the connection dropped was: {detail}. Check the battery voltage and current settings by hand, or apply a profile again once you know what state the battery is in - a confirmed match clears this.

battery_type_not_user_define.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": the inverter accepts battery voltage changes only while the battery type is "{required_type}", and it is currently "{current_type}". Change the battery type yourself and try again - the integration never changes it.

apply_preflight_read_failed.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": could not read the inverter's current settings.

apply_preflight_field_not_reported.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": the device did not report {field}.

apply_preflight_voltage_out_of_range.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": {field} target {target} is outside its own {min}-{max} range.

apply_preflight_current_allow_list_unrea.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": could not read the device's current allow-list for {field}.

apply_preflight_current_not_offered.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": {field} target {target} A is not currently offered by the device.

apply_preflight_voltage_order_conflict.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": cannot reach {field} target {target} in any write order - {blockers}.

apply_rolled_back.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": the inverter refused or did not confirm {field} (target {target}, device now reports {read_back}); the device now reports every changed setting back at its previous value.

apply_rollback_incomplete.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": the inverter refused or did not confirm {field} (target {target}, device now reports {read_back}); rollback could not be fully confirmed - battery is left in a mixed state, check settings manually.

apply_transport_unknown_not_transmitted.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": the connection failed before the command changing {field} could be sent - nothing was transmitted; {field} was last confirmed at {last_confirmed}.

apply_transport_unknown_may_have_reached.message: Cannot apply profile "{profile}": a command changing {field} may have reached the inverter, but no confirming reply came back afterward, so the resulting state is unknown; {field} was last confirmed at {last_confirmed}.
